_notes: Ground truth is (file, page range), not chunk id. Chunk ids change every time
chunking parameters change, which would make the eval set useless for the exact
experiment it exists to run -- tuning chunk size. File and page survive re-chunking
and are verifiable by a human opening the PDF.
A retrieved chunk counts as relevant when the filename matches AND its
[page_start, page_end] overlaps the expected range. Page ranges are given with a
little slack because a chunk that answers the question may begin on the previous
Every question below was written by reading the chunk first, so the answer is known
to be present in the corpus. Questions are phrased the way a user would ask them,
not by copying source wording -- otherwise this measures string overlap rather

unanswerable.question: What is the exact monthly price in USD of an m5.large EC2 instance in us-east-1?
unanswerable.why: Plausibly in scope -- retrieval returns cost chunks -- but the corpus contains no prices.
